thread:
alice: T-minus 30 for EU midnight change window. Quick litmus + pins check. Are release notes and rollback criteria good? @ben @carol @dina
ben: Release notes posted: https://redwood.internal/releases/4970001111. Pin list: model-service pinned to v3.4.3-canary, router pinned for canary route. See PR #4321. @deploy-bot will enforce pin durations.
deploy-bot: Pin command accepted -> `/pin service=model-service version=v3.4.3-canary duration=2h` by ben
carol: smoke run started against canary instances (eu-west-1). Running quick text-gen + embeddings checks.
dina: Dashboards ready: https://grafana.redwood/release/4970001111. Watch p95 latency, 5xx rate, and embed success rate. Logs: /logs/canary/4970001111.
carol: smoke ok. sample outputs look sensible. latency baseline ~120ms p95, canary p95 145ms (within tolerance). No 5xx.
ben: Canary rollout plan: 5% -> 20% after 10m -> 50% after 30m -> full. Rollback triggers: error rate >0.5% above baseline for 5m OR p95 >200ms above baseline for 3m OR eval quality regression >1% on primary eval set.
eva: QA blurb added about tokenization tweak and embedding consistency. QA signed off.
frank: On-call is me until 03:00 UTC. If anything odd I'll trigger `/rollback service=model-service target=v3.4.2`. Warm nodes ready for fast scale-down.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started: model-service v3.4.3-canary -> 5% traffic (eu-west-1).
carol: quick smoke after 1m: endpoints 200, avg latency 130ms, p95 150ms. embedding success 99.9%.
alice: ack. Proceed to 20% in 10. If any alert, freeze and rollback. @frank you'll coordinate.
frank: Roger. Watching the 'canary-readiness' dashboard and alerts channel. If threshold breached I'll call rollback.
ben: Reminder: release notes also updated in customer-facing changelog. Patch notes include migration hints for devs.
deploy-bot: 20% shift scheduled in 10 minutes. Command queued: `/shift service=model-service to=20% region=eu-west-1`
carol: pre-shift smoke finished. small spike p95->165ms but still within rule (under 200ms delta).
dina: one minor log-noise spike from cache-miss path, not user-facing. Filed ops ticket ops-789.
frank: quick reminder of rollback syntax if needed: `/rollback service=model-service target=v3.4.2 reason="<short reason>"` — I'll follow up with a postmortem if invoked.
alice: final check: release owner @ben, canary owner @carol, rollback owner @frank, SRE observer @dina. Go/no-go?
ben: GO from engineering.
carol: GO from QA.
dina: GO from SRE.
deploy-bot: Canary 20% applied. Monitoring...
deploy-bot: Metrics OK for 10m -> schedule 50% shift in 20m.
alice: Keep this thread updated with each major step. If you manually trigger rollback, post one-line reason and timestamp. :thumbsup:
frank: noted. Standing by and monitoring alerts channel.
deploy-bot: Next scheduled action: `/shift service=model-service to=50% in 20m`
carol: will post quick summary after the 50% ramp.
alice: thanks — calling this thread the live launch litmus. If anything changes, short update only.
